payload.explanation: The diagnostic report identifies the business request (session_5204ec24263c, UPDATE inventory stock decrement) as blocked on a transactionid lock chain rooted at session_63f52b0f345f, an idle-in-transaction session holding uncommitted row locks. The state report independently confirms session_63f52b0f345f is project-owned and eligible for rollback_session, and that the business request remains pending with stock still 200. No evidence supports large-data, index, or vacuum causes. Rolling back the root blocker releases the lock chain and lets the business request complete (expected stock 199), while preserving unrelated transactions.
